metadata.citation: Kodak, KODAK PROFESSIONAL TRI-X 320 and 400 Films, F-4017, October 2021, page 8; process table page 3.
metadata.datasource: https://kodakprofessional.com/sites/default/files/wysiwyg/film/f4017_trix_320400.pdf; PDF SHA256 1d86b030cf7a8502e6f1414c630fa2cda30b68df53f49bccccce73c9c6562078; source SHA256 1bec44b919419bf44893936d0fb8b1923dac1ee0ae14d57a0967c10b5c513536. 400TX 35 mm; T-MAX Developer 1:4, 6 minutes, small tank, 20 C, agitation every 30 seconds; diffuse visual density. Exposure origin -1.06083963434 log10(lux seconds). Rebuild scripts/prepare_trix400.py; see docs/trix400.md. Publication drawing, not batch-specific measurement. Left plotted density is an estimated base+fog floor, not an unexposed-strip measurement. D-min+1.0 effective sensitivity; other density threshold retained for comparison, not a separate layer. No measured silver/base spectrum, matched T-MAX grain, halation, or angular-scattering calibration. Published upper solid sensitivity labelled D=1.0; threshold ordering is unresolved, labels not silently corrected. 2007 Kodak edition attributes sensitivity/MTF to older 5063; later omission of caveat does not prove remeasurement. Endpoint log-slope spectral tails to -12 are extrapolated, not measured hard cutoffs. Exposure zero is estimated base+fog plus 1.0 density; D55 RGB midgray mapping is not absolute ISO calibration. Neutral silver and base spectra; no angular scattering, fluorescence or real scanner calibration. No real Tri-X photographs calibrate the RGB adaptation; CIE training and BabelColor holdout test only spectral reconstruction. Characteristic curve clamps outside plotted range; no inferred shoulder or extra latitude. One aggregate density record, not a measured layer decomposition. No stock-specific grain, halation or MTF calibration; builtin preset disables uncalibrated effects.
